summary: Three unrelaxed [CH][C][O]*+H* IS candidates and the exact [CH][C]OH* FS seed were constructed for user review; no VASP job was submitted.

payload.objective: Prepare reviewable Fe(110) endpoints for [CH][C][O]* + H* -> [CH][C]OH* + * before adsorption relaxation and TS work.
current_evidence: The exact product graph is local CARE candidate 03 [CH][C]OH*, not the previously optimized [CH][CH][O]* isomer.
IS A places transferred H49 at an adjacent long bridge with O-H=2.065585 A and H-Fe=1.700000 A.
IS B places H49 at an adjacent hollow with O-H=2.199383 A and H-Fe=1.700000 A.
IS C is a far long-bridge reference with O-H=5.231999 A and H-Fe=1.700000 A.
All four candidates preserve Fe45, bottom 18 fixed atoms, the same cell and atom order; the three IS POSCAR audits and the chemistry-aware endpoint reviews pass.
payload.one_executable_step: Obtain user review of IS A/B/C and the FS seed before preparing any GPU pre-relaxation or VASP submission package.
payload.submission_boundary: No GPU or VASP job is authorized. The structures are unrelaxed candidates and no adsorption energy or endpoint acceptance is claimed.
done_when: The user selects or rejects the endpoint candidates.
Selected endpoints are relaxed and scientifically reviewed before TS path construction.
Any adsorption-energy claim uses accepted compatible surface and exact-isomer gas references.
